tokens_pulled_before_accounting_update.meaning: the addRewards external token pull via transferFrom has completed before the reward accounting update occurs
tokens_pulled_before_accounting_update.checkpoint: during addRewards, at the point of the reward accounting update

monetary_extraction_occurred.meaning: in some scenarios, monetary extraction occurs (potential, conditional outcome)

assumptions: The external token pull is performed by addRewards via transferFrom.
Reward accounting update is the bookkeeping step that must follow the token pull.

unresolved.description: The frozen intent states an ordering requirement (transferFrom before accounting update), but the selected impact 'monetary_extraction' is only a potential, scenario-conditional outcome with no stated observable magnitude, subject, or direct relation to the ordering; the grammar cannot faithfully bind the potential extraction to the ordering violation without inventing the causal/observable relation.

Report does not state whether the attacker is an authorized caller of addRewards or claimRewards, nor a concrete prior accounting state before addRewards; the increased accounting is produced by the checked action itself.

limitations: No frozen P sources were selected; precondition_ids is empty.
The impact is potential/conditional ('in some scenarios'); it is not asserted as an inevitable outcome.
The ordering requirement is represented only as a Boolean occurrence symbol; the actual transferFrom/accounting-update sequence is not numerically or structurally bound.
Other impacts and other intents for this impact are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
